layout.upload_page: min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 md:p-8 relative z-10
layout.player_wrapper: w-full h-screen bg-black flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden
layout.player_canvas: w-full max-w-[1920px] aspect-video relative overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl rounded-none md:rounded-2xl ring-1 ring-white/10

motion.mesh_blobs: Keyframe animations moving 4-5 blurred colored orbs across the container in figure-8 or elliptical paths (duration 15s-30s, infinite, alternate).
motion.lyrics_scroll: Smooth scroll utilizing containerRef.scrollTo({ top: ..., behavior: 'smooth' }).

components.mesh_background: Absolute inset-0 z-0 overflow-hidden. Contains 4-5 div elements sized w-[60vw] h-[60vw] rounded-full blur-[120px] opacity-70 mix-blend-screen. Colors fed dynamically from album art extraction. Add a static SVG noise overlay on top at 20% opacity to prevent banding.
components.intro_screen: Absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-8. Album art at w-64 h-64 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
components.lyric_container: Absolute inset-0 z-10 w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto flex flex-col py-[40vh] px-12 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar gap-10 mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black 15%, black 85%, transparent)
components.upload_form: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-12 w-full max-w-2xl flex flex-col gap-8 shadow-2xl
components.controls: Absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-30 flex items-center gap-6 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl px-8 py-4 rounded-full border border-white/10 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300

features.color_extraction: Implement a simple canvas-based average color extractor or use `colorthief` (if added by main agent) to pull 4 distinct colors from the uploaded album art.
features.lrc_parsing: Parse LRC text by splitting newlines and using regex `\[(\d{2}):(\d{2})\.(\d{2,3})\](.*)` to generate an array of objects `{ time: seconds, text: string }`. Ensure empty lines are rendered as breaks.
features.audio_sync: Use standard HTML5 Audio. On `timeupdate`, find the last lyric whose time is <= currentTime. Set as active. Auto-scroll container so active lyric is centered.
features.intro_logic: If currentTime < firstLyric.time, show `intro_screen` and hide `lyric_container`. When reached, crossfade them.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Shadcn UI cards for the player interface. Keep it bare HTML/Tailwind for maximum performance and layout control.

To achieve the Mesh Gradient: use standard absolutely positioned divs with inline style background-color set from the extracted album art colors. Apply `filter: blur(140px)` and CSS animations to translate/scale them. Overlay a subtle noise texture to eliminate color banding.
Ensure the layout strictly enforces a 1920x1080 aspect ratio in the center of the screen via `aspect-video`, mimicking a TV display.
For the LRC parsing, remember some LRC files have 2 digits for milliseconds and some have 3. Handle both.

Implement the 'Apple Music Sing' scroll: When active lyric changes, calculate `offsetTop` of the active HTML element, and call `containerRef.current.scrollTo({ top: offsetTop - containerHeight / 2 + elementHeight / 2, behavior: 'smooth' })`.
Ensure `mask-image` (or `-webkit-mask-image`) is used on the lyric container to seamlessly fade out lyrics at the top and bottom of the screen.
Use standard HTML input elements for the upload form, styled heavily with Tailwind glassmorphism (`bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`).
Do not implement persistence. Use React State to hold the uploaded files (URL.createObjectURL for MP3 and Image, FileReader for LRC text) and pass them to the Player component.
Use Helvetica strictly for the player text (`font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`). Do not use Inter for lyrics.
